objective: Evaluate transfer of the locked adiabatic real-gas vessel-discharge model to an independent scaled forklift hydrogen release mass-flow trace.
claim_boundary: This holdout tests time-resolved source mass flow in one 13.45 MPa, 3.63 L scaled release through a 3.56 mm restriction. It does not validate enclosure dispersion, ignition, overpressure, forklift geometry, station control, or separation distance.

source.title: Experimental investigation of hydrogen release and ignition from fuel cell powered forklifts in enclosed spaces
source.digitization_license: GNU GPL v3 as distributed with HyRAM+; original article rights remain with the publisher

known_before_freeze.data_file_access_before_freeze: The file was cryptographically hashed but no numerical row was opened. Public report and HyRAM+ setup code supplied apparatus inputs and the x3/y3 series identity.

independence.limitation: The digitization is not an original logger export and the experiment shares Sandia/SRI institutions with the Schefer campaigns; this is experiment-level, not institution-level, transfer.

locked_model.description: Existing HEOS well-mixed adiabatic rigid-vessel model with maximum real-gas isentropic mass flux and the independently published Cd=0.75.

eligibility.insufficient_data_policy: Archive an ineligible result without extrapolation or substitution of a calculated curve.

median_absolute_percentage_error_percent.support: measured flow at least 10 percent of peak

aggregate_decision.claim_supported: all three primary endpoint screens pass
aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: Any failed screen remains archived and prohibits an independent transient mass-flow validation claim from this dataset.
